name: orwell
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Orwell instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Orwell tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Orwell through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Orwell Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Orwell only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
